ideas.title: Add shooting star particles
ideas.description: Random shooting stars that streak across the sky with trailing particles. Triggered every 8-15 seconds.

ideas.title: Interactive constellation drawing
ideas.description: Users can click stars to draw constellation lines. Lines glow and fade. Store in localStorage.

ideas.title: Moon phase API integration
ideas.description: Replace calculated moon phase with real astronomical data. Show accurate phase for current date.

ideas.title: Sunflower field parallax
ideas.description: Multi-layer parallax for sunflower field. Foreground flowers sway more, background less. Depth-based blur.

ideas.title: Philosophy quote carousel
ideas.description: Auto-rotating quote cards with fade transitions. Each quote tied to current section's visual element.

ideas.title: Daily generated philosophy facts
ideas.description: Use Hermes agent to generate new philosophy facts weekly. Store in siteData.json via cron job.

ideas.title: Loading Optimizations
ideas.description: Astro-native loading optimizations: client:idle hydration, inline critical CSS, modulepreload, progressive 3D layers, content-visibility, SVG compression, Nginx caching+gzip, reduced geometry, loader progress bar. v2 PRD with Astro-compatible patterns.

ideas.title: Flute click — SVG bansuri + music notes
ideas.description: Click anywhere spawns an animated Krishna's bansuri (bamboo flute) SVG at cursor position with floating music note symbols (♪♫♬). Flute animates in/out with spring easing.

ideas.title: White 3D moon + glow
ideas.description: Change 3D moon material from yellow (0xfff8e7) to white (0xffffff) with reduced emissive. Glow sphere also white instead of warm yellow.

ideas.title: Diverse colorful tulips
ideas.description: Replace all-yellow tulip palette with 16 diverse colors (red, orange, pink, magenta, purple, golden, amber, coral, crimson, orchid, vermillion, rose, violet, peach). Each tulip randomized with per-petal variation.

ideas.title: Mobile tulip visibility fix
ideas.description: Tulips were invisible on mobile due to small scale (0.5-0.9), low Y position (-0.5), and narrow aspect ratio. Fixed with larger scale (0.8-1.4), higher Y (-0.1), wider aspect (1.0×1.6).

ideas.title: Remove speaker/audio toggle
ideas.description: Remove the audio toggle button (🔇) from BaseLayout and ambient-audio.js script tag. Flute click + notes remain intact.

ideas.title: ASCII moon brightness + shadow
ideas.description: Lighten ASCII moon text color from #c9a84c to #e8d48a with stronger text-shadow glow. Reduce moon shadow overlay opacity from 0.88 to 0.72.

ideas.title: Glitch shader fix
ideas.description: Fix glitch shader R/B channel swap bug (was reading .b for both r and b). Scope chromatic aberration to glitch lines only (~2% per scanline) instead of every frame.

ideas.title: Blue color cast removal
ideas.description: Remove blue point light washing out scene. Change from 0x4466aa to warm 0xffeedd at lower intensity. Reduce post-processing shader saturation from 1.4 to 1.0.

ideas.title: Single-layer flower rendering
ideas.description: Replace 3-layer parallax flower system with proven single-layer approach (a0ce3ef reference). Larger scales, higher Y, correct counts (10 sunflowers, 6 tulips desktop; 6 sunflowers, 3 tulips mobile).

ideas.title: Realistic randomized tulips
ideas.description: Replace abstract oval tulip shapes with realistic cup/bloom forms. 12 non-yellow colors (red, pink, purple, magenta, coral, orange, rose, violet, etc.). Per-tulip randomization: petal count 5-7, width/height variation, curl factor. Petal gradients, edge highlights, vein lines.

ideas.title: Scroll-driven starry night sky parallax
ideas.description: The sky subtly rotates and shifts based on scroll position. Stars at different depths move at different speeds. Moon rises as you scroll. Background color shifts with scroll.

ideas.title: Impressionist brushstroke cursor trail
ideas.description: Custom cursor that leaves painterly brushstroke trails using Canvas 2D particle system. Colors sampled from current theme palette. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

ideas.title: Three.js 3D geometry for all scene elements
ideas.description: Convert all canvas-texture sprites to proper Three.js 3D geometry: sunflowers (TubeGeometry stem + disk + 36 petals in 3 layers), lilies (trumpet petals + 6 stamens with anthers + pistil + spots), music notes (sphere head + cylinder stem + cone flag). Moon upgraded with dual glow spheres. All elements use MeshStandardMaterial with emissive for self-illumination. Billboard heads face camera via lookAt in animate loop.

ideas.title: Code architecture refactoring
ideas.description: Extracted 29KB CSS from BaseLayout to external main.css. Extracted changelog JS and moon-phase JS to external files. Converted 5 duplicated section blocks to data-driven loop. Removed 21 dead files (Three.js component files, shader modules, stale tests). Removed post-processing pipeline (EffectComposer + Glitch shaders). Added modulepreload for Three.js CDN. HTML inline CSS reduced from 45KB to 2KB.

ideas.title: 3D Cypress Tree Silhouettes
ideas.description: Tall, dark cypress tree silhouettes rendered as Three.js ExtrudeGeometry that sway gently in the background. 5 trees on desktop, 2 on mobile. MeshBasicMaterial for zero lighting cost. Integrates with existing parallax scroll system.

ideas.title: Interactive Firefly Swarm
ideas.description: A swarm of 3D firefly points (40 desktop, 20 mobile) that drift organically using damped random walk velocity fields. Each firefly pulses with warm golden light via custom shader. Fireflies scatter away from mouse cursor within 3-unit radius and slowly return. Additive blending for ethereal glow.

ideas.title: Scroll-Driven Painting Reveal
ideas.description: A large painting (loaded from Wikimedia Commons) displayed on a Three.js PlaneGeometry that progressively reveals based on scroll position. Custom shader divides the image into horizontal bands with slight horizontal variation for organic reveal. 150vh scroll section drives the effect.

ideas.title: Theme Color Scheme Switcher
ideas.description: A floating theme picker that lets visitors manually switch between the 5 impressionist color schemes (starry-night, sunflower, midnight-wave, tulip-garden, moonlit-silver). Orphaned PRD from earlier generation — needs review before implementation.

ideas.title: Dynamic Time-of-Day Atmosphere System
ideas.description: The 3D scene subtly shifts its ambient atmosphere based on the visitor's local time — warm golden dawn, bright midday, rich sunset tones, or deep night. Background, stars, moon, waves, and flower colors all respond to time-of-day with smooth interpolation between phases.

ideas.title: Remove artist-specific references from codebase

ideas.title: Accessibility audit & core fixes
ideas.description: Implement foundational accessibility improvements: skip-navigation link for keyboard users, visible focus indicators on all interactive elements (flute button, theme switcher, quote dots, carousel), ARIA labels on icon-only controls, aria-live region for quote carousel auto-rotation announcements, and respect for prefers-reduced-motion (disable firefly drift, shooting stars, brushstroke cursor, and note float animations when reduced motion is preferred). Pure CSS + minimal JS overlay module, no scene-init.js changes.

ideas.title: Adaptive performance quality scaler
ideas.description: A lightweight FPS monitor that dynamically scales 3D scene quality to maintain smooth performance. Tracks rolling average FPS over 60 frames. If FPS drops below 30: reduces star count by 40%, halves flower/wave segments, and disables firefly swarm. If FPS recovers above 50 for 5 seconds, restores quality tiers. Quality level persisted in sessionStorage so returning visitors with known-slow devices skip the measurement phase. Implemented as a standalone public/js/performance-scaler.js module that reads sceneConfig flags — no scene-init.js modifications.

ideas.title: Client-side content search overlay
ideas.description: A keyboard-triggered search overlay (press '/' or click a search icon) that indexes all facts, quotes, koans, and section intros from siteData.json and content.json. Fuzzy-matches visitor queries against text content and returns results grouped by theme (Moon, Philosophy, Gita, Shiva, Art). Each result shows the text snippet with highlighted match and a 'jump to section' link. Pure client-side with a small JSON index built at page load. No backend, no Three.js — a standalone public/js/content-search.js module with a floating search bar UI that respects the dark impressionist theme.

ideas.title: Offline PWA Shell — Service Worker Cache
ideas.description: A tiny service worker (public/sw.js) that caches the HTML shell, main CSS, loader CSS, all public/js/ modules, fonts.googleapis.com CSS responses, and siteData.json/content.json. First visit caches assets; subsequent visits load instantly from cache with a network-first fallback for JSON content. Registration code in BaseLayout.astro is:inline block. No backend changes. The sw.js uses a versioned cache name (atrija-vX) so future deploys bust the cache. Shows a subtle 'offline-ready' toast on first successful cache. Total added code: ~60 lines SW + ~15 lines registration.

ideas.title: Section Progress Navigator — Dot/Bar Scroll Indicator
ideas.description: A minimal vertical dot navigation bar fixed to the right edge of the viewport showing all major sections (Hero, Today, Moon, Philosophy, Gita, Shiva, Art, Footer). Current section is highlighted via IntersectionObserver. Dots are keyboard-navigable (Tab + Enter scrolls to section). On mobile, collapses to a subtle thin progress bar. Respects prefers-reduced-motion — disables smooth scroll on reduced motion. Pure CSS + standalone public/js/section-nav.js module. Zero Three.js impact. Fills a clear UX gap: the site has 7+ scroll sections with no way to know where you are or jump between sections.

ideas.title: Reader Mode — 3D Canvas Dimmer Toggle
ideas.description: A floating eye-icon button (bottom-left, above the footer) that toggles Reader Mode: the Three.js canvas fades to opacity 0.05 and pointer-events none, revealing only the dark gradient background. All text content sections get enhanced readability styling (slightly larger text, increased line-height, subtle text-shadow). Toggles back to full 3D on second click. State persists in sessionStorage so the preference survives within a session. Integrates with the existing data-reduced-motion attribute — automatically enters Reader Mode when reduced motion is detected. Pure CSS + minimal JS overlay module (public/js/reader-mode.js). No scene-init.js changes. Addresses both accessibility (users who are overwhelmed by motion) and practical needs (battery saving on mobile).
